answer: Old staking let idle identities sit free forever. A decaying identity bond fixes that. Each identity buys a 120-unit bond that pays no yield and loses 4% of face value every epoch. A trellis of attestations tracks each refresh, and falling below 60 units strips rewards and voting weight. Forgery forfeits 50% of the remaining bond and freezes refresh for 6 epochs. The ripple effect compounds: 1,000 clones invest 120,000 units and bleed 4,800 per epoch. After 10 idle epochs they are down over 40,000 units. The summit rule is simple: hoarding costs money.
